We are looking for a talented, experienced and highly motivated QA Engineer to join a strong group, developing one of the world’s top leading online gaming brands.
We are looking for a QA engineer with a strong technical background, responsible for testing large-scale back-end systems, DB, and E2E flows using the latest technologies and practices.
 What You’ll Be Doing
Writing testing documents such as STR, STD, STP, etc.
Fully understand logical designs and BRD and build thorough testing plans accordingly.
Complete all tests procedures needed from the QA environment to post-production.
Working in agile methodology, part of a scrum team, and responsible for the Quality assurance of the team
Generate complex testing procedures.
Working closely with development, System analyst, product managers, and other QA teams in the company.
 Job Requirements
 What We’re Looking For
At least 4 years of experience in server-side testing.
Ability to see the full picture from the requirement, through the physical implementation till the user end.
Experience with testing server-side.
Understanding of software lifecycle.
Proven technical skills.
High-level English.
 You Might Also Have
Computer science degree or equivalent.
Experience with TFS, MTM, SoapUI, SQL, web services.
Knowledge and understanding of the agile methodology.
